name: Joybound People & Pets - Community Veterinary Care
description: Low-cost non-urgent veterinary care for pets of very low income Contra Costa County residents
fullDescription: Joybound People & Pets (formerly Tony La Russa's ARF) Community Veterinary Care provides low-cost, non-urgent veterinary care at its Walnut Creek clinic for Contra Costa County residents facing serious financial crisis.
whatTheyOffer:
- Low-cost, non-urgent medical treatment for pets
- Care at Joybound's clinic in Walnut Creek
- Care for dogs and cats
- Not for routine, preventive, elective, exploratory, or specialty care
howToGetIt:
1. Must be a Contra Costa County resident facing serious financial crisis
2. Household income must be at or below HUD very low income limits
3. Contact Joybound's Resource Center at 925-256-1273 ext. 450
4. Provide photo ID and proof of income for all household members (not including dependents)
5. If approved, schedule an appointment for your pet
keywords: Joybound, ARF, Tony La Russa, low-cost vet, Contra Costa, veterinary care, pet medical, Walnut Creek, dog, cat, vaccinations
